stage1.impression: A deep, dim bar seen through a shop window, with a believable 35 mm eye-level perspective and warm 2700 K pools on the plinth and counter. But it reads as CG. The people are smeared grey mannequins. The band under the ceiling is a flat beige strip that lights nothing. The right third and the ceiling are dead black. The terrazzo reads as oversized granite. Five or six saturated colours compete (tinted spheres, a purple shade, RGB rings), so no single EARF object is the hero. As it stands, a magazine would see a generic dark bar, not a specific place: the lantern does not yet read as an object.

blocking_9: The people read as motionless or naturally blurred humans, not smeared blobs
The lantern reads as a glowing oak object at a glance: the amber fins show as glowing, edge-lit acrylic that throws light onto the ceiling and the baffle, not as a flat painted strip
Frame lum_median between 22 and 40 with the lantern's interior at 45 or more, so the Tropos pair is legible
The right third (x 950-1200) carries readable plaster or reflection detail instead of a dead black slab
The terrazzo reads at real scale (small honed chips), not as polished coarse granite
No fireflies or speckle in the band or on the ceiling
The frame's saturated colour is concentrated in EARF's own pieces, with nothing else (the RGB rings, the purple shade) pulling the eye from the lantern

defects.what: Seated and standing figures at shutter 1.0 smear into faceless grey blobs with ghost doubles; they read as CG mannequins
Banquette figures are smeared and doubled, with shapeless heads
The acrylic fin band reads as a flat, uniform beige panel with no fin edges and no glow onto the ceiling above (ceiling median 12.1); white firefly specks in it
Featureless near-black slab over a fifth of the frame (median 8.4)
The ceiling is a black void (median 4.7, crush 29%) apart from pinpoint downlights; it reads empty rather than shadowed
The window plinth's terrazzo chips are far too large and high-contrast; it reads as polished granite countertop, with soft blotchy reflection pools
A full-height dark mullion cuts the left of the frame and the shelf composition
Bright thin shelf LED lines read as retail or signage lighting
The RGB ring object reads as neon or a screen graphic floating in the porch opening, which kills the 'one colour' read
Pendant shades in purple, orange and white over the bar add saturated colour that competes with the hero

changes.problem: The motion-blurred people read as grey ghost mannequins, the single strongest CG tell.

evidence.measured: Visual at 3x: the figures smear into shapeless blobs with doubled heads and no limbs or clothing read

change.to: 0.15; keep the faces turned away from camera (backs and three-quarter backs) instead of hiding them with blur, and drop the count from 8 to 4 or 5 so each one reads

changes.expected: Seated figures read as people in coats at the counter and banquette, with only a slight blur on a moving hand

changes.problem: The lantern does not glow: the fin band is a flat beige strip and throws no light onto the ceiling or down the baffle.

evidence.measured: Ceiling above the band: lum_median 12.1. The band itself: median 121.6, range 116, uniform, with no fin edges

changes.expected: The band reads as glowing amber with lit fin edges, a soft wash spills onto the ceiling soffit and slats, and faint haze shows its light

changes.problem: Inside the lantern the Tropos pair and the end of the room are too dark to read, so the hero is lost.

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair spots; the trap

changes.expected: The Ember pair reads as two lit tinted forms framed by the porch, the brightest coloured accent at the end of the room

changes.problem: The frame overall is below the readable night range.
changes.expected: Frame median rises to about 24 to 30 with the plinth still unclipped

changes.problem: The right third is a dead black slab with no plaster texture or street reflection.

change.to: fill 0.12 W/m2 plus one 14 W 30 deg 2700 K wall-grazing spot on the right plaster wall (as for the shop wall); glass reflection 0.6 kept so faint street lights read on that dark field

changes.expected: The lime plaster shows a soft graze gradient and a few faint reflected street lights, so the edge of the frame holds detail

changes.problem: The window plinth's terrazzo reads as polished coarse granite at the wrong scale.

evidence.measured: Visual at 2x: chips about 15-25 mm with high contrast against the ground; lum_range 130

change.setting: terrazzo chip size and ground tone
change.from: large, high-contrast chips on a dark ground
change.to: chips 4-10 mm, a lighter warm-grey ground with lower chip contrast, honed (roughness about 0.45)

changes.expected: Reads as honed terrazzo at arm's length, with soft broad highlights under the Cores instead of blotches

changes.problem: The shelf LED lines are thin bright strokes that read as retail signage and pull the eye to the left edge.

evidence.measured: Lines at p95 80.9 against an oak median of 17.8

change.setting: the shelf and back-bar lines; the shop wall spots

changes.expected: The oak shelves and the tinted Cores are lit by the spots, and the lines become a subtle under-shelf wash

changes.problem: A full-height mullion splits the left of the frame and the dead right wall takes a fifth of the frame, so the lantern sits small in the middle.

evidence.measured: Visual: a dark vertical crossing the shelves; the right wall spans x 950-1200

change.to: [-3.2, 3.5, 1.5] looking at [13.0, 4.2, 1.95], 40 mm, placed so the mullion falls at or outside the left edge

changes.expected: The lantern is larger and nearer the centre, and the mullion and dead wall are cropped down

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the number of saturated colours (the tinted Cores, the purple and orange Hemisphere shades, the RGB rings)
out_of_scope.why: These are EARF products in their tints, fixed by the card; they break the one-colour read and dilute the hero, so the owner should decide whether fewer of them belong in this hero frame

out_of_scope.request: Make the RGB ring object (Mother EARF?) read as a physical object rather than a neon graphic
out_of_scope.why: It is a product as placed; its look is not a lighting change. Lighting it from the side with Mother's spot may help, but its design is fixed

out_of_scope.request: Make the fins visibly thicker or deeper so they read as premium cast acrylic
out_of_scope.why: The acrylic band's place and fins are fixed architecture
